authoring_contract.title: UDS Brand Deep-Research Pack Specification - revised user version

baseline_reference.rule: Reference only; research pack never silently replaces trusted/project/vehicle/family evidence.

claims.exact_claim: PSA-RE distinguishes AEE2001 VAN+CAN/K-line, AEE2004 first full-CAN, and AEE2010 second full-CAN architectures; AEE2004 explicitly includes 500 kbit/s HS CAN, 125 kbit/s low-speed CAN, LIN, EOBD and UDS.
claims.action_if_connected: Classify diagnostic generation independently from mechanical platform; unsupported VAN/K-line paths remain explicit transport states.
claims.promotion_test: Correlate generation with VIN/model facts and gateway/module inventory on physical vehicles.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Architecture generation is not a DID decoder scope.

claims.exact_claim: arduino-psa-diag provides a large non-exhaustive PSA ECU-family route catalogue including ABS/ESP 6AD/68D, BSI/body 752/652, EPS 6B5/695, engine 6A8/688, transmission 6A9/689, telematics 764/664, HVAC 76D/66D and traction-battery MSB 6B4/694.
claims.action_if_connected: Use the route catalogue as a bounded presence/identity candidate set before generic enumeration.
claims.promotion_test: Bind each reached route to ECU identity and platform/model evidence.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Non-exhaustive family catalogue; route presence does not prove ECU fitment.

claims.exact_claim: The immutable WiCAN Peugeot e-208 profile reads battery DIDs D410, D860 and D815 from 6B4/694, D49C from 6A6/686, and D8EF/D434 from 6A2/682.
claims.action_if_connected: After exact e-208 classification, probe these routes, capture identity, then query scoped DIDs.
claims.promotion_test: Physically reproduce on e-208; compare ECU fingerprints with e-2008/Corsa-e/other related platforms before family widening.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Exact e-208 evidence, not automatic Stellantis-wide truth.

claims.exact_claim: Immutable WiCAN profiles for Peugeot iOn and Citroën C-Zero both use request 761, response 762, service 21 local identifier 01 for SOC with source formula (raw/2)-5.
claims.action_if_connected: Use this exact branch only after iOn/C-Zero identification; do not apply mainstream PSA UDS assumptions.
claims.promotion_test: Physically validate one iOn/C-Zero and compare with Mitsubishi i-MiEV family if desired.

claims.exact_claim: PyPSADiag contains a PSA recognition read using 22F080 on 752/652 in one workflow, and also exposes routines, zone writes, DTC clearing, flashing and key-bruteforce capabilities.
claims.action_if_connected: Treat F080 as a vendor identity research lead only; never project PyPSADiag write/routine/security/bruteforce functionality into automatic discovery.
claims.promotion_test: Verify whether F080 is readable in default session on target BSI families and normalize returned identity fields before use.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Tool capability is not authorization or evidence that every PSA ECU supports the same workflow.
